dialogue.text: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.
dialogue.zh: 兩千多年前，古代中國學者觀察了我們自然界中變化的規律，包括氣候、季節的更替和天文現象。
dialogue.ja: 2000年以上前、古代の中国の学者たちは自然界の変化するパターン、気候、季節の移り変わり、そして天文学を観察しました。
dialogue.local: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.
dialogue.en: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.

dialogue.text: The scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24 parts, creating the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.
dialogue.zh: 學者們測量並將太陽的年度運動分成24個部分，創造了24節氣，這些節氣用來指導古代中國的農業。
dialogue.ja: 学者たちは太陽の年間の動きを測定し、24の部分に分けて24節気を作り出しました。これは古代中国の農業を管理するために使われました。
dialogue.local: The scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24 parts, creating the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.
dialogue.en: The scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24 parts, creating the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.

dialogue.text: According to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions of Chinese people.
dialogue.zh: 直到今天，這項發明仍然指導著數億中國人的生活和傳統。
dialogue.ja: 今日に至るまで、この発明は何億もの中国人の生活や伝統を導いています。
dialogue.local: According to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions of Chinese people.
dialogue.en: According to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions of Chinese people.

dialogue.text: On or around December 27th of each year, Chinese people get ready for the winter solstice festival.
dialogue.zh: 每年12月27日左右，中國人準備迎接冬至節。
dialogue.ja: 毎年12月27日頃、中国の人々は冬至の祭りの準備をします。
dialogue.local: On or around December 27th of each year, Chinese people get ready for the winter solstice festival.
dialogue.en: On or around December 27th of each year, Chinese people get ready for the winter solstice festival.

dialogue.text: This is a festival to mark the shortest day of the year.
dialogue.zh: 這是一個標誌著一年中白天最短的節日。
dialogue.ja: これは一年で最も昼が短い日を祝う祭りです。
dialogue.local: This is a festival to mark the shortest day of the year.
dialogue.en: This is a festival to mark the shortest day of the year.

dialogue.text: There's always been a significant date in the Chinese calendar.
dialogue.zh: 這在中國曆法中一直是一個重要的日子。
dialogue.ja: これは中国の暦の中で常に重要な日でした。
dialogue.local: There's always been a significant date in the Chinese calendar.
dialogue.en: There's always been a significant date in the Chinese calendar.

dialogue.text: Emperors would have held a ceremony, and students might have huddled together and worshipped the future, feasting on dumplings in the master.
dialogue.zh: 皇帝會舉行儀式，學生們可能會聚在一起祈福，並在師傅家裡享用餃子宴。
dialogue.ja: 皇帝は儀式を行い、学生たちは集まって未来を祈り、師匠の家で餃子を食べて祝いました。
dialogue.local: Emperors would have held a ceremony, and students might have huddled together and worshipped the future, feasting on dumplings in the master.
dialogue.en: Emperors would have held a ceremony, and students might have huddled together and worshipped the future, feasting on dumplings in the master.

dialogue.text: Winter solstice is the 22nd of the ancient 24 solar terms, but it was the very first to be created.
dialogue.zh: 冬至是古代24節氣中的第22個，但卻是最早被創立的節氣。
dialogue.ja: 冬至は古代の24節気のうち22番目ですが、最初に作られた節気でもあります。
dialogue.local: Winter solstice is the 22nd of the ancient 24 solar terms, but it was the very first to be created.
dialogue.en: Winter solstice is the 22nd of the ancient 24 solar terms, but it was the very first to be created.

dialogue.text: Documents show that at least 2500 years ago, the ancient Chinese concluded that in the northern hemisphere, this was the shortest day with the longest hours of darkness.
dialogue.zh: 文獻顯示，至少在2500年前，古代中國人已經認識到北半球這一天是白天最短、黑夜最長的日子。
dialogue.ja: 文献によると、少なくとも2500年前に古代中国人は北半球でこの日が最も昼が短く、夜が最も長い日であると結論づけました。
dialogue.local: Documents show that at least 2500 years ago, the ancient Chinese concluded that in the northern hemisphere, this was the shortest day with the longest hours of darkness.
dialogue.en: Documents show that at least 2500 years ago, the ancient Chinese concluded that in the northern hemisphere, this was the shortest day with the longest hours of darkness.

dialogue.text: This made it a very special note of time, they thought, and the beginning of the next cycle saw ancient Chinese emperors offering prayers on winter solstice.
dialogue.zh: 他們認為這是一個非常特別的時間點，下一個週期的開始，古代中國皇帝會在冬至祭祀祈禱。
dialogue.ja: 彼らはこれを非常に特別な時間の節目と考え、次の周期の始まりとして古代中国の皇帝は冬至に祈りを捧げました。
dialogue.local: This made it a very special note of time, they thought, and the beginning of the next cycle saw ancient Chinese emperors offering prayers on winter solstice.
dialogue.en: This made it a very special note of time, they thought, and the beginning of the next cycle saw ancient Chinese emperors offering prayers on winter solstice.

dialogue.text: Xi'an in China's Shanxi province has a long history, more than 3,000 years.
dialogue.zh: 中國山西省的西安有著超過三千年的悠久歷史。
dialogue.ja: 中国の陝西省にある西安は、3000年以上の長い歴史を持っています。
dialogue.local: Xi'an in China's Shanxi province has a long history, more than 3,000 years.
dialogue.en: Xi'an in China's Shanxi province has a long history, more than 3,000 years.

dialogue.text: It is believed this is where the winter solstice festival first turned into a Chinese festival, and where it first became an official festival, one of the 24 solar terms.
dialogue.zh: 據信這裡是冬至節首次成為中國節日的地方，也是首次成為24節氣之一的官方節日。
dialogue.ja: ここが冬至の祭りが初めて中国の祭りとなり、24節気の一つとして公式の祭りになった場所だと信じられています。
dialogue.local: It is believed this is where the winter solstice festival first turned into a Chinese festival, and where it first became an official festival, one of the 24 solar terms.
dialogue.en: It is believed this is where the winter solstice festival first turned into a Chinese festival, and where it first became an official festival, one of the 24 solar terms.

dialogue.text: If we ask ourselves, who knows the most about Chinese traditional culture in Xi'an, it must be one person.
dialogue.zh: 如果問誰最了解西安的中國傳統文化，那一定是某個人。
dialogue.ja: もし西安で中国の伝統文化を最もよく知っているのは誰かと問えば、それはある一人の人物に違いありません。
dialogue.local: If we ask ourselves, who knows the most about Chinese traditional culture in Xi'an, it must be one person.
dialogue.en: If we ask ourselves, who knows the most about Chinese traditional culture in Xi'an, it must be one person.

dialogue.text: Working at the Xi'an Intangible Cultural Protection Centre, he is a member of this active rescue and protection group, also the first line of defence for Chinese culture.
dialogue.zh: 他在西安非物質文化保護中心工作，是這個積極救援和保護團隊的成員，也是中國文化的第一道防線。
dialogue.ja: 彼は西安の無形文化保護センターで働いており、この積極的な救助と保護グループの一員であり、中国文化の最前線の防衛者でもあります。
dialogue.local: Working at the Xi'an Intangible Cultural Protection Centre, he is a member of this active rescue and protection group, also the first line of defence for Chinese culture.
dialogue.en: Working at the Xi'an Intangible Cultural Protection Centre, he is a member of this active rescue and protection group, also the first line of defence for Chinese culture.

dialogue.text: From 4 to 8 to 24, China's 24 solar terms originated 3,000 years ago in the Zhou Dynasty.
dialogue.zh: 中國的24節氣起源於3000年前的周朝，從4到8再到24個節氣。
dialogue.ja: 中国の24節気は3000年前の周王朝に起源があり、4つから8つ、そして24節気へと発展しました。
dialogue.local: From 4 to 8 to 24, China's 24 solar terms originated 3,000 years ago in the Zhou Dynasty.
dialogue.en: From 4 to 8 to 24, China's 24 solar terms originated 3,000 years ago in the Zhou Dynasty.

dialogue.text: The winter solstice festival happens around the same time as the Chinese New Year, and is equally important.
dialogue.zh: 冬至節大約與中國新年同時發生，且同樣重要。
dialogue.ja: 冬至の祭りは中国の旧正月とほぼ同じ時期に行われ、同じくらい重要です。
dialogue.local: The winter solstice festival happens around the same time as the Chinese New Year, and is equally important.
dialogue.en: The winter solstice festival happens around the same time as the Chinese New Year, and is equally important.

dialogue.text: Every year at the winter solstice festival, Xi'an's drum tower quarter will be alive with ritual noises and prayers hosting the liveliest of festivals.
dialogue.zh: 每年冬至節，西安鼓樓區都會充滿儀式的聲音和祈禱，舉辦最熱鬧的節慶活動。
dialogue.ja: 毎年冬至の祭りには、西安の鼓楼地区が儀式の音や祈りで賑わい、最も活気ある祭りが開催されます。
dialogue.local: Every year at the winter solstice festival, Xi'an's drum tower quarter will be alive with ritual noises and prayers hosting the liveliest of festivals.
dialogue.en: Every year at the winter solstice festival, Xi'an's drum tower quarter will be alive with ritual noises and prayers hosting the liveliest of festivals.

dialogue.text: People trade in various household goods in preparation for the New Year.
dialogue.zh: 人們交易各種家用品，為新年做準備。
dialogue.ja: 人々は新年の準備のために様々な家庭用品を売買します。
dialogue.local: People trade in various household goods in preparation for the New Year.
dialogue.en: People trade in various household goods in preparation for the New Year.

dialogue.text: The customs of Xi'an and winter solstice festival are a part of Wang Jun's research interests.
dialogue.zh: 西安和冬至節的習俗是王軍研究的興趣之一。
dialogue.ja: 西安と冬至の祭りの習慣は王軍の研究対象の一部です。
dialogue.local: The customs of Xi'an and winter solstice festival are a part of Wang Jun's research interests.
dialogue.en: The customs of Xi'an and winter solstice festival are a part of Wang Jun's research interests.

dialogue.text: In class, he meets renowned pastry chef, Ma Shunli.
dialogue.zh: 在課堂上，他遇到了著名的糕點師馬順麗。
dialogue.ja: 授業で彼は有名な菓子職人の馬順麗に出会います。
dialogue.local: In class, he meets renowned pastry chef, Ma Shunli.
dialogue.en: In class, he meets renowned pastry chef, Ma Shunli.

dialogue.text: She has inherited this most Chinese form of intangible heritage: dumplings.
dialogue.zh: 她繼承了這種最具中國特色的非物質文化遺產——餃子。
dialogue.ja: 彼女は最も中国らしい無形文化遺産である餃子を受け継いでいます。
dialogue.local: She has inherited this most Chinese form of intangible heritage: dumplings.
dialogue.en: She has inherited this most Chinese form of intangible heritage: dumplings.

dialogue.text: Starting at age 16, she has now made, as we say in Chinese, wrapped dumplings for 33 years.
dialogue.zh: 她從16歲開始包餃子，至今已經包了33年。
dialogue.ja: 16歳から餃子を包み始め、今では33年間包み続けています。
dialogue.local: Starting at age 16, she has now made, as we say in Chinese, wrapped dumplings for 33 years.
dialogue.en: Starting at age 16, she has now made, as we say in Chinese, wrapped dumplings for 33 years.

dialogue.text: Of all the customs Chinese people carry out at winter solstice festival, dumpling eating is number one.
dialogue.zh: 在冬至節所有習俗中，吃餃子是最重要的。
dialogue.ja: 冬至の祭りで中国人が行うすべての習慣の中で、餃子を食べることが一番です。
dialogue.local: Of all the customs Chinese people carry out at winter solstice festival, dumpling eating is number one.
dialogue.en: Of all the customs Chinese people carry out at winter solstice festival, dumpling eating is number one.

dialogue.text: About 1,800 years ago, there lived a healer called Zhang Zhongjing.
dialogue.zh: 大約1800年前，有一位名叫張仲景的醫生。
dialogue.ja: 約1800年前、張仲景という治療者がいました。
dialogue.local: About 1,800 years ago, there lived a healer called Zhang Zhongjing.
dialogue.en: About 1,800 years ago, there lived a healer called Zhang Zhongjing.

dialogue.text: He went back to his hometown on winter solstice one year, and found many villages with frostbitten ears.
dialogue.zh: 有一年冬至，他回到家鄉，發現許多村莊的人耳朵被凍傷了。
dialogue.ja: ある年の冬至に彼は故郷に戻り、多くの村で耳が凍傷になっているのを見つけました。
dialogue.local: He went back to his hometown on winter solstice one year, and found many villages with frostbitten ears.
dialogue.en: He went back to his hometown on winter solstice one year, and found many villages with frostbitten ears.

dialogue.text: Zhang Zhongjing ordered his apprentice to cook some mutton broth laced with chili peppers and herbs.
dialogue.zh: 張仲景命令徒弟煮一些加了辣椒和草藥的羊肉湯。
dialogue.ja: 張仲景は弟子に唐辛子と薬草を入れた羊肉スープを作るよう命じました。
dialogue.local: Zhang Zhongjing ordered his apprentice to cook some mutton broth laced with chili peppers and herbs.
dialogue.en: Zhang Zhongjing ordered his apprentice to cook some mutton broth laced with chili peppers and herbs.

dialogue.text: He wrapped it in dough pockets shaped like ears and passed them out to everyone in hot soup.
dialogue.zh: 他把湯包成像耳朵形狀的麵團，熱湯中分給大家。
dialogue.ja: 彼はそれを耳の形をした生地で包み、熱いスープで皆に配りました。
dialogue.local: He wrapped it in dough pockets shaped like ears and passed them out to everyone in hot soup.
dialogue.en: He wrapped it in dough pockets shaped like ears and passed them out to everyone in hot soup.

dialogue.text: A bowl of hot dumplings in the belly and the frostbitten villages were saved.
dialogue.zh: 一碗熱騰騰的餃子讓凍傷的村莊得以康復。
dialogue.ja: 熱い餃子の一杯で凍傷の村々は救われました。
dialogue.local: A bowl of hot dumplings in the belly and the frostbitten villages were saved.
dialogue.en: A bowl of hot dumplings in the belly and the frostbitten villages were saved.

dialogue.text: Since then, every winter solstice festival people imitate this by making ear-shaped dumplings.
dialogue.zh: 從此，每年冬至節人們模仿這個故事，做出像耳朵形狀的餃子。
dialogue.ja: それ以来、毎年冬至の祭りには人々が耳の形をした餃子を作るようになりました。
dialogue.local: Since then, every winter solstice festival people imitate this by making ear-shaped dumplings.
dialogue.en: Since then, every winter solstice festival people imitate this by making ear-shaped dumplings.

dialogue.text: A long time in the making, this tale is the universal backstory of the dumpling eating at winter solstice festival.
dialogue.zh: 這個故事流傳已久，是冬至吃餃子的普遍由來。
dialogue.ja: 長い年月をかけて、この話は冬至に餃子を食べる普遍的な背景となりました。
dialogue.local: A long time in the making, this tale is the universal backstory of the dumpling eating at winter solstice festival.
dialogue.en: A long time in the making, this tale is the universal backstory of the dumpling eating at winter solstice festival.

dialogue.text: Dafachan is the longest-standing restaurant to serve such a dumpling banquet.
dialogue.zh: 大發餐館是提供這種餃子宴最悠久的餐廳。
dialogue.ja: 大発餐館はこのような餃子の宴を提供する最も古いレストランです。
dialogue.local: Dafachan is the longest-standing restaurant to serve such a dumpling banquet.
dialogue.en: Dafachan is the longest-standing restaurant to serve such a dumpling banquet.

dialogue.text: Nearly 100 years have passed since they began making the superb dumplings.
dialogue.zh: 他們開始製作這些優秀餃子已經近百年了。
dialogue.ja: 彼らが素晴らしい餃子を作り始めてからほぼ100年が経ちました。
dialogue.local: Nearly 100 years have passed since they began making the superb dumplings.
dialogue.en: Nearly 100 years have passed since they began making the superb dumplings.

dialogue.text: It is now considered one of the legends of ancient Xi'an.
dialogue.zh: 現在被認為是古老西安的傳奇之一。
dialogue.ja: 現在では古代西安の伝説の一つとされています。
dialogue.local: It is now considered one of the legends of ancient Xi'an.
dialogue.en: It is now considered one of the legends of ancient Xi'an.

dialogue.text: Over 300 kinds of dumplings, more than 300 flavours to choose from, munching on these is an unforgettable way to spend the festival.
dialogue.zh: 超過300種餃子，300多種口味可選，品嚐這些餃子是度過節日難忘的方式。
dialogue.ja: 300種類以上の餃子、300以上の味があり、これらを食べることは祭りを過ごす忘れられない方法です。
dialogue.local: Over 300 kinds of dumplings, more than 300 flavours to choose from, munching on these is an unforgettable way to spend the festival.
dialogue.en: Over 300 kinds of dumplings, more than 300 flavours to choose from, munching on these is an unforgettable way to spend the festival.

dialogue.text: Winter solstice festival every year sees Dafachan dumpling for all at its busiest.
dialogue.zh: 每年冬至節，大發餐館的餃子生意最為繁忙。
dialogue.ja: 毎年冬至の祭りには、大発餐館の餃子が最も忙しくなります。
dialogue.local: Winter solstice festival every year sees Dafachan dumpling for all at its busiest.
dialogue.en: Winter solstice festival every year sees Dafachan dumpling for all at its busiest.

dialogue.text: All the staff are on from 6 in the morning to 11 at night, churning out dumplings without stopping.
dialogue.zh: 所有員工從早上6點工作到晚上11點，不停地製作餃子。
dialogue.ja: スタッフ全員が朝6時から夜11時まで働き、休むことなく餃子を作り続けます。
dialogue.local: All the staff are on from 6 in the morning to 11 at night, churning out dumplings without stopping.
dialogue.en: All the staff are on from 6 in the morning to 11 at night, churning out dumplings without stopping.

dialogue.text: Winter solstice festival is a special day for Dafachan.
dialogue.zh: 冬至節對大發餐館來說是一個特別的日子。
dialogue.ja: 冬至の祭りは大発餐館にとって特別な日です。
dialogue.local: Winter solstice festival is a special day for Dafachan.
dialogue.en: Winter solstice festival is a special day for Dafachan.

dialogue.text: The restaurant can sell a whopping 4 to 5,000 dumplings.
dialogue.zh: 餐廳一天能賣出四到五千個餃子。
dialogue.ja: レストランは一日に4000から5000個もの餃子を売ることができます。
dialogue.local: The restaurant can sell a whopping 4 to 5,000 dumplings.
dialogue.en: The restaurant can sell a whopping 4 to 5,000 dumplings.

dialogue.text: In my memory, every time you eat dumplings, you are meant to be having a happy time.
dialogue.zh: 在我記憶中，每次吃餃子都是快樂的時光。
dialogue.ja: 私の記憶では、餃子を食べるたびに楽しい時間を過ごしているはずです。
dialogue.local: In my memory, every time you eat dumplings, you are meant to be having a happy time.
dialogue.en: In my memory, every time you eat dumplings, you are meant to be having a happy time.

dialogue.text: It's either a family gathering or a festival reunion of some kind.
dialogue.zh: 那要麼是家庭聚會，要麼是某種節日團聚。
dialogue.ja: それは家族の集まりか、何らかの祭りの再会です。
dialogue.local: It's either a family gathering or a festival reunion of some kind.
dialogue.en: It's either a family gathering or a festival reunion of some kind.

dialogue.text: Chinese people are very particular about cooking dumplings as one of their favourite foods.
dialogue.zh: 中國人對烹飪餃子非常講究，因為它是他們最喜愛的食物之一。
dialogue.ja: 中国人は餃子を料理することに非常にこだわっています。餃子は彼らのお気に入りの食べ物の一つだからです。
dialogue.local: Chinese people are very particular about cooking dumplings as one of their favourite foods.
dialogue.en: Chinese people are very particular about cooking dumplings as one of their favourite foods.

dialogue.text: A table full of exquisite dumplings, what a feast.
dialogue.zh: 一桌精緻的餃子，真是一場盛宴。
dialogue.ja: 美味しい餃子が並んだテーブル、なんてご馳走でしょう。
dialogue.local: A table full of exquisite dumplings, what a feast.
dialogue.en: A table full of exquisite dumplings, what a feast.

dialogue.text: This must be a blessed Chinese winter solstice solar term, indeed.
dialogue.zh: 這一定是個幸福的中國冬至節氣。
dialogue.ja: これはまさに祝福された中国の冬至節気に違いありません。
dialogue.local: This must be a blessed Chinese winter solstice solar term, indeed.
dialogue.en: This must be a blessed Chinese winter solstice solar term, indeed.

dialogue.text: This is the place I've never experienced in England.
dialogue.zh: 這是我在英國從未體驗過的地方。
dialogue.ja: これは私がイギリスで経験したことのない場所です。
dialogue.local: This is the place I've never experienced in England.
dialogue.en: This is the place I've never experienced in England.

dialogue.text: You know how to eat dumplings.
dialogue.zh: 你知道怎麼吃餃子。
dialogue.ja: 餃子の食べ方を知っていますね。
dialogue.local: You know how to eat dumplings.
dialogue.en: You know how to eat dumplings.

dialogue.text: It's not hard to understand why the Chinese marvel at the flavour, and visitors from overseas love it too.
dialogue.zh: 不難理解為什麼中國人驚嘆於這味道，海外遊客也很喜愛它。
dialogue.ja: なぜ中国人がその味に驚嘆し、海外からの訪問者もそれを愛するのか理解しやすいです。
dialogue.local: It's not hard to understand why the Chinese marvel at the flavour, and visitors from overseas love it too.
dialogue.en: It's not hard to understand why the Chinese marvel at the flavour, and visitors from overseas love it too.

dialogue.text: Teacher Wang is leading me on a winter solstice solar term tour of Xi'an, starting with food.
dialogue.zh: 王老師帶我參加西安冬至節氣之旅，從美食開始。
dialogue.ja: 王先生が私を案内して、西安の冬至節気ツアーを食べ物から始めます。
dialogue.local: Teacher Wang is leading me on a winter solstice solar term tour of Xi'an, starting with food.
dialogue.en: Teacher Wang is leading me on a winter solstice solar term tour of Xi'an, starting with food.

dialogue.text: First came to China, I quickly recognised that there were set customs at different times of the year.
dialogue.zh: 剛來中國時，我很快發現一年中不同時節有固定的習俗。
dialogue.ja: 中国に来たばかりの頃、私は一年の異なる時期に決まった習慣があることにすぐ気づきました。
dialogue.local: First came to China, I quickly recognised that there were set customs at different times of the year.
dialogue.en: First came to China, I quickly recognised that there were set customs at different times of the year.

dialogue.text: When to eat something in particular, and when to wear something special.
dialogue.zh: 什麼時候吃特定的食物，什麼時候穿特別的衣服。
dialogue.ja: いつ特定のものを食べ、いつ特別な服を着るかということです。
dialogue.local: When to eat something in particular, and when to wear something special.
dialogue.en: When to eat something in particular, and when to wear something special.

dialogue.text: At first, I didn't completely understand the unwritten rules.
dialogue.zh: 起初，我並不完全理解這些不成文的規則。
dialogue.ja: 最初は、私はこれらの暗黙のルールを完全には理解していませんでした。
dialogue.local: At first, I didn't completely understand the unwritten rules.
dialogue.en: At first, I didn't completely understand the unwritten rules.

dialogue.text: That wasn't till I embarked on the 24 solar terms tour, I finally got it.
dialogue.zh: 直到我開始24節氣之旅，我才終於明白。
dialogue.ja: 24節気のツアーに参加して初めて、私はそれを理解しました。
dialogue.local: That wasn't till I embarked on the 24 solar terms tour, I finally got it.
dialogue.en: That wasn't till I embarked on the 24 solar terms tour, I finally got it.

dialogue.text: Long-term observation has led to the synchronicity between people and nature, the experience of harmonious coexistence.
dialogue.zh: 長期觀察促成了人與自然的同步，體驗和諧共存。
dialogue.ja: 長期の観察により、人と自然の同期、調和のとれた共存の体験が生まれました。
dialogue.local: Long-term observation has led to the synchronicity between people and nature, the experience of harmonious coexistence.
dialogue.en: Long-term observation has led to the synchronicity between people and nature, the experience of harmonious coexistence.

dialogue.text: These seriously lifelike soldiers and warhorses are modelled on China's first unified feudal dynasty, the Qin. These are the terracotta warriors.
dialogue.zh: 這些栩栩如生的兵馬俑是以中國第一個統一封建王朝秦朝為模型，這就是兵馬俑。
dialogue.ja: これらの非常にリアルな兵士と戦馬は、中国初の統一封建王朝である秦朝をモデルにしています。これが兵馬俑です。
dialogue.local: These seriously lifelike soldiers and warhorses are modelled on China's first unified feudal dynasty, the Qin. These are the terracotta warriors.
dialogue.en: These seriously lifelike soldiers and warhorses are modelled on China's first unified feudal dynasty, the Qin. These are the terracotta warriors.

dialogue.text: The working people spent their days observing the sun and the moon, charting the growth of their animals and plants.
dialogue.zh: 勞動人民日夜觀察日月，記錄動植物的生長。
dialogue.ja: 労働者たちは日々太陽と月を観察し、動植物の成長を記録しました。
dialogue.local: The working people spent their days observing the sun and the moon, charting the growth of their animals and plants.
dialogue.en: The working people spent their days observing the sun and the moon, charting the growth of their animals and plants.

dialogue.text: This is how the 24 solar terms came into being, this calendar like no other.
dialogue.zh: 這就是24節氣的由來，一個獨特的曆法。
dialogue.ja: これが24節気が生まれた経緯であり、他に類を見ない暦です。
dialogue.local: This is how the 24 solar terms came into being, this calendar like no other.
dialogue.en: This is how the 24 solar terms came into being, this calendar like no other.

dialogue.text: After the Qin dynasty, we had the Han dynasty.
dialogue.zh: 秦朝之後，是漢朝。
dialogue.ja: 秦朝の後に漢朝がありました。
dialogue.local: After the Qin dynasty, we had the Han dynasty.
dialogue.en: After the Qin dynasty, we had the Han dynasty.

dialogue.text: The dominant forces of East, who equals the Roman Empire in the West.
dialogue.zh: 東方的主導力量，相當於西方的羅馬帝國。
dialogue.ja: 東の支配的勢力は、西のローマ帝国に匹敵します。
dialogue.local: The dominant forces of East, who equals the Roman Empire in the West.
dialogue.en: The dominant forces of East, who equals the Roman Empire in the West.

dialogue.text: These 24 solar terms were confirmed in Xi'an, the capital of the Han dynasty.
dialogue.zh: 這24節氣在漢朝首都西安被確立。
dialogue.ja: これらの24節気は漢朝の首都である西安で確立されました。
dialogue.local: These 24 solar terms were confirmed in Xi'an, the capital of the Han dynasty.
dialogue.en: These 24 solar terms were confirmed in Xi'an, the capital of the Han dynasty.

dialogue.text: The Chinese language, Hanyu, Chinese characters, Hanzi, Chinese clothing have many things named in reference to the Han dynasty.
dialogue.zh: 漢語、漢字、中國服飾中有許多名稱都與漢朝有關。
dialogue.ja: 中国語の漢語、漢字、中国の衣服には多くのものが漢朝に由来しています。
dialogue.local: The Chinese language, Hanyu, Chinese characters, Hanzi, Chinese clothing have many things named in reference to the Han dynasty.
dialogue.en: The Chinese language, Hanyu, Chinese characters, Hanzi, Chinese clothing have many things named in reference to the Han dynasty.

dialogue.text: And this land under my feet, once there was located this powerful dynasty, an imperial palace stood right here.
dialogue.zh: 我腳下這片土地曾是這個強大王朝的所在地，皇宮就建在這裡。
dialogue.ja: 私の足元のこの土地にはかつてこの強大な王朝があり、皇宮がここに建っていました。
dialogue.local: And this land under my feet, once there was located this powerful dynasty, an imperial palace stood right here.
dialogue.en: And this land under my feet, once there was located this powerful dynasty, an imperial palace stood right here.

dialogue.text: Hard to imagine, owning a palace seven times bigger than Beijing's Forbidden City, how mighty would this emperor have been?
dialogue.zh: 難以想像，擁有一座比北京故宮大七倍的宮殿，這位皇帝會有多麼強大？
dialogue.ja: 北京の紫禁城の7倍の大きさの宮殿を持っていたとは想像しにくいですが、この皇帝はどれほど強大だったのでしょうか？
dialogue.local: Hard to imagine, owning a palace seven times bigger than Beijing's Forbidden City, how mighty would this emperor have been?
dialogue.en: Hard to imagine, owning a palace seven times bigger than Beijing's Forbidden City, how mighty would this emperor have been?

dialogue.text: I see lots of children, young children, young people, interacting with each other.
dialogue.zh: 我看到許多孩子、年輕人彼此互動。
dialogue.ja: 多くの子供たちや若者たちが互いに交流しているのが見えます。
dialogue.local: I see lots of children, young children, young people, interacting with each other.
dialogue.en: I see lots of children, young children, young people, interacting with each other.

dialogue.text: Undoubtedly Chinese economic culture and art experienced thousands of years, or even tens of thousands of years of accumulation, then realized a gorgeous bloom of the Han dynasty.
dialogue.zh: 毫無疑問，中國的經濟文化和藝術經歷了數千年甚至數萬年的積累，最終在漢朝達到輝煌的頂峰。
dialogue.ja: 間違いなく、中国の経済文化と芸術は何千年、あるいは何万年もの蓄積を経て、漢朝で華麗な花を咲かせました。
dialogue.local: Undoubtedly Chinese economic culture and art experienced thousands of years, or even tens of thousands of years of accumulation, then realized a gorgeous bloom of the Han dynasty.
dialogue.en: Undoubtedly Chinese economic culture and art experienced thousands of years, or even tens of thousands of years of accumulation, then realized a gorgeous bloom of the Han dynasty.

dialogue.text: And today, although China's capital has moved to the world famous Beijing, Xi'an is still alive and kicking.
dialogue.zh: 如今，儘管中國的首都已遷至世界著名的北京，西安依然生機勃勃。
dialogue.ja: そして今日、中国の首都は世界的に有名な北京に移りましたが、西安は今も活気に満ちています。
dialogue.local: And today, although China's capital has moved to the world famous Beijing, Xi'an is still alive and kicking.
dialogue.en: And today, although China's capital has moved to the world famous Beijing, Xi'an is still alive and kicking.

dialogue.text: As teacher Wang said, this historic land is rich in cultural treasures, and teacher Wang's work is to discover and protect these cultural heritage.
dialogue.zh: 正如王老師所說，這片歷史悠久的土地富含文化寶藏，而王老師的工作就是發掘和保護這些文化遺產。
dialogue.ja: 王先生が言ったように、この歴史的な土地は文化的な宝物に恵まれており、彼の仕事はこれらの文化遺産を発見し保護することです。
dialogue.local: As teacher Wang said, this historic land is rich in cultural treasures, and teacher Wang's work is to discover and protect these cultural heritage.
dialogue.en: As teacher Wang said, this historic land is rich in cultural treasures, and teacher Wang's work is to discover and protect these cultural heritage.

dialogue.text: Winter solstice solar term every year is an excellent time to repair farm tools.
dialogue.zh: 每年冬至節氣是修理農具的好時機。
dialogue.ja: 冬至の節気は毎年、農具を修理するのに最適な時期です。
dialogue.local: Winter solstice solar term every year is an excellent time to repair farm tools.
dialogue.en: Winter solstice solar term every year is an excellent time to repair farm tools.

dialogue.text: The popularization of iron tools and the development of farmland irrigation came hand in hand with advances to the complexity in farming.
dialogue.zh: 鐵製工具的普及和農田灌溉的發展伴隨著農業複雜性的提升。
dialogue.ja: 鉄製工具の普及と農地の灌漑の発展は、農業の複雑化の進歩とともに進みました。
dialogue.local: The popularization of iron tools and the development of farmland irrigation came hand in hand with advances to the complexity in farming.
dialogue.en: The popularization of iron tools and the development of farmland irrigation came hand in hand with advances to the complexity in farming.

dialogue.text: This beautiful window papercut features best wishes for the new year.
dialogue.zh: 這幅美麗的窗花剪紙展現了對新年的美好祝福。
dialogue.ja: この美しい窓の切り紙は新年の幸運を願っています。
dialogue.local: This beautiful window papercut features best wishes for the new year.
dialogue.en: This beautiful window papercut features best wishes for the new year.

dialogue.text: A piece of red paper, a pair of the sharpest scissors and dexterous hands.
dialogue.zh: 一張紅紙，一把鋒利的剪刀和靈巧的雙手。
dialogue.ja: 一枚の赤い紙、鋭いハサミ、そして器用な手。
dialogue.local: A piece of red paper, a pair of the sharpest scissors and dexterous hands.
dialogue.en: A piece of red paper, a pair of the sharpest scissors and dexterous hands.

dialogue.text: This is the folk custom that traditionally goes on after winter solstice solar term.
dialogue.zh: 這是冬至節氣後傳統延續的民俗習慣。
dialogue.ja: これは冬至の節気の後に伝統的に続く民間の習慣です。
dialogue.local: This is the folk custom that traditionally goes on after winter solstice solar term.
dialogue.en: This is the folk custom that traditionally goes on after winter solstice solar term.

dialogue.text: In the cold days of deep winter, when it might be snowing heavily outside, people will spend the hours using bright red paper to cut up beautiful illustrations to decorate their windows and add their wishes for the upcoming New Year.
dialogue.zh: 在寒冷的深冬，外面可能大雪紛飛，人們會花時間用鮮紅的紙剪出美麗的圖案，裝飾窗戶，並寄託對新年的祝福。
dialogue.ja: 厳しい冬の寒い日、外は激しく雪が降っているかもしれませんが、人々は明るい赤い紙を使って美しい絵を切り抜き、窓を飾り、来る新年への願いを込めます。
dialogue.local: In the cold days of deep winter, when it might be snowing heavily outside, people will spend the hours using bright red paper to cut up beautiful illustrations to decorate their windows and add their wishes for the upcoming New Year.
dialogue.en: In the cold days of deep winter, when it might be snowing heavily outside, people will spend the hours using bright red paper to cut up beautiful illustrations to decorate their windows and add their wishes for the upcoming New Year.

dialogue.text: Other than traditional paper cutting, people also need another red touch in their lives to decorate their winter nests.
dialogue.zh: 除了傳統剪紙，人們還需要另一種紅色元素來裝飾冬季的家園。
dialogue.ja: 伝統的な切り紙のほかに、人々は冬の住まいを飾るためにもう一つの赤い要素を必要とします。
dialogue.local: Other than traditional paper cutting, people also need another red touch in their lives to decorate their winter nests.
dialogue.en: Other than traditional paper cutting, people also need another red touch in their lives to decorate their winter nests.

dialogue.text: Bamboo sticks as thin as toothpicks are divided up by hand, dancing between dexterous fingers and finally woven into a lantern frame.
dialogue.zh: 像牙籤一樣細的竹條被手工分開，在靈巧的手指間舞動，最後編織成燈籠框架。
dialogue.ja: 爪楊枝ほど細い竹の棒が手で分けられ、器用な指の間で踊り、最後にランタンの枠に編まれます。
dialogue.local: Bamboo sticks as thin as toothpicks are divided up by hand, dancing between dexterous fingers and finally woven into a lantern frame.
dialogue.en: Bamboo sticks as thin as toothpicks are divided up by hand, dancing between dexterous fingers and finally woven into a lantern frame.

dialogue.text: Lighting the candle in it, the stars burn bright.
dialogue.zh: 點燃燭光，星星般閃耀。
dialogue.ja: その中にろうそくを灯すと、星が明るく輝きます。
dialogue.local: Lighting the candle in it, the stars burn bright.
dialogue.en: Lighting the candle in it, the stars burn bright.

dialogue.text: We imagine them as people on the cold winter's night, sending wishes for New Year and the promising spring to come.
dialogue.zh: 我們想像它們是寒冷冬夜裡的人們，傳遞對新年和春天的美好祝願。
dialogue.ja: 私たちはそれらを寒い冬の夜にいる人々と想像し、新年とやってくる希望に満ちた春への願いを送ります。
dialogue.local: We imagine them as people on the cold winter's night, sending wishes for New Year and the promising spring to come.
dialogue.en: We imagine them as people on the cold winter's night, sending wishes for New Year and the promising spring to come.

dialogue.text: When I was visiting the drum town, a 10-year-old Chinese child touched me to be.
dialogue.zh: 當我參觀鼓樓鎮時，一個10歲的中國孩子觸動了我。
dialogue.ja: 私が鼓楼の町を訪れたとき、10歳の中国の子供が私に触れました。
dialogue.local: When I was visiting the drum town, a 10-year-old Chinese child touched me to be.
dialogue.en: When I was visiting the drum town, a 10-year-old Chinese child touched me to be.

dialogue.text: He pointed to the drum with the 24 solar terms on it and told his parents that these are our 24 solar terms.
dialogue.zh: 他指著鼓上刻著的24節氣，告訴父母這是我們的24節氣。
dialogue.ja: 彼は24節気が描かれた太鼓を指さし、両親に「これが私たちの24節気だ」と言いました。
dialogue.local: He pointed to the drum with the 24 solar terms on it and told his parents that these are our 24 solar terms.
dialogue.en: He pointed to the drum with the 24 solar terms on it and told his parents that these are our 24 solar terms.

dialogue.text: Now the 24 solar terms are more than just Chinese wisdom and Chinese treasures.
dialogue.zh: 現在24節氣不僅是中國的智慧和寶藏。
dialogue.ja: 今や24節気は単なる中国の知恵や宝物以上のものです。
dialogue.local: Now the 24 solar terms are more than just Chinese wisdom and Chinese treasures.
dialogue.en: Now the 24 solar terms are more than just Chinese wisdom and Chinese treasures.

dialogue.text: They have become an intangible heritage of the world.
dialogue.zh: 它們已成為世界的非物質文化遺產。
dialogue.ja: それらは世界の無形文化遺産となりました。
dialogue.local: They have become an intangible heritage of the world.
dialogue.en: They have become an intangible heritage of the world.

dialogue.text: Like the Silk Road of old, spreading out from the ancient Xi'an, this treasure has arrived at a new millennium and now faces outwards towards the entire world.
dialogue.zh: 就像古老的絲綢之路一樣，從古老的西安傳播開來，這份寶藏已經來到新千年，並面向全世界。
dialogue.ja: 古代の西安から広がった古いシルクロードのように、この宝物は新しい千年に到達し、今や世界全体に向かっています。
dialogue.local: Like the Silk Road of old, spreading out from the ancient Xi'an, this treasure has arrived at a new millennium and now faces outwards towards the entire world.
dialogue.en: Like the Silk Road of old, spreading out from the ancient Xi'an, this treasure has arrived at a new millennium and now faces outwards towards the entire world.
